\begin{abstract}
We study 340 matches from the 2019 season. The method reaches 0.81 fitness and keeps 38\% of the
possessions, 12,430 in total.
\end{abstract}
\section{1 Data}
We use 340 matches~\cite{ref2020} (see Section~\ref{sec:2}).
After filtering, 12\,430 possessions remain, which is 38.0\% of the raw data.
\begin{equation}
  f = \sum_{i=1}^{2} x_i^2
\end{equation}
The model reaches a fitness of 0.8134 on the held-out split.
